root_cause: PostgreSQL materializes owner default ACL entries when the explicit unknown grant creates relacl; the additive R.6 carrier incorrectly compared the complete target ACL domain to only the selected unknown ACL identity.
safe_remediation: Keep the complete table_acl domain signed, derive the migration-equivalent unknown-grantee subset using the closed allowed grantees, and require that subset to equal the pinned unknown ACL identity. A later Action must use fresh A/B outputs and a new output directory.
